# About TechBridge Training Center

## Overview
TechBridge Training Center is a fictional training center that helps students and professionals develop practical technology skills. The center offers instructor-led courses, hands-on exercises, and small projects.

## Mission
Our mission is to make technology education accessible and practical, helping learners build skills they can use in academic projects and the workplace.

## Training Format
- Courses are delivered in person at the TechBridge training facility.
- Classes are held three days per week.
- Each class lasts two hours.
- Students complete practical exercises and a final course project.
- Course materials are provided digitally.

## Available Courses
1. Artificial Intelligence (AI)
2. Web Development
3. Data Analysis

## Contact Information
- Email: info@techbridge.example
- Phone: +962 6 555 0140
- Address: 25 University Street, Amman, Jordan

## Working Hours
Sunday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

# Artificial Intelligence Course

## Course Name
Practical Artificial Intelligence

## Description
This course introduces learners to the foundations of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Students explore how AI systems learn from data, practice preparing datasets, train simple machine learning models, and evaluate model performance. The course includes hands-on exercises using Python.

## Duration
8 weeks (48 training hours).

## Prerequisites
- Basic computer skills.
- Basic Python programming knowledge.
- Basic understanding of mathematics is helpful but not required.

## Target Audience
- University students interested in AI.
- Beginner programmers who want to explore machine learning.
- Professionals who want an introduction to practical AI.

## Learning Outcomes
By the end of the course, students will be able to:
- Explain basic AI and machine learning concepts.
- Prepare a simple dataset for analysis.
- Train and evaluate a basic machine learning model.
- Present a small AI project.

## Schedule
Sunday, Tuesday, and Thursday, 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM.

## Course Fee
180 JOD.

# Data Analysis Course

## Course Name
Data Analysis with Python and Power BI

## Description
This course teaches learners how to turn raw data into useful insights. Students learn data collection basics, data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, and visualization. They use Python with Pandas for data preparation and Power BI to create interactive dashboards. The final activity is a small data analysis project.

## Duration
6 weeks (36 training hours).

## Prerequisites
- Basic computer skills.
- Basic spreadsheet knowledge is recommended.
- No previous Python experience is required.

## Target Audience
- University students interested in data.
- Beginners who want to learn data analysis.
- Professionals who work with reports and business data.

## Learning Outcomes
By the end of the course, students will be able to:
- Identify common data quality issues.
- Clean and organize datasets.
- Perform basic exploratory data analysis.
- Create charts and dashboards.
- Communicate findings using data.

## Schedule
Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday, 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM.

## Course Fee
160 JOD.

# Registration Process

## How to Register
Applicants can register for a course by following these steps:

1. Visit the TechBridge Training Center or email info@techbridge.example.
2. Choose one of the available courses.
3. Complete the registration form with your full name, email address, phone number, and selected course.
4. Provide any information needed to confirm that you meet the course prerequisites.
5. Pay the course fee at the center.
6. Receive a confirmation email with the course schedule and start date.

## Registration Requirements
- Applicants must provide accurate contact information.
- Applicants should review the prerequisites before registering.
- Some courses may require a short placement discussion to check the learner's starting level.

## Payment
Payment is made in Jordanian dinars (JOD) at the training center. A place is confirmed after payment is completed.

## Cancellation Policy
Applicants may request a cancellation up to seven days before the course start date. Approved cancellations receive a full refund. Requests made fewer than seven days before the start date are reviewed by the administration.

# Web Development Course

## Course Name
Full-Stack Web Development Fundamentals

## Description
This course teaches students how to build interactive websites. Learners start with HTML and CSS, then study JavaScript and basic front-end development. They are introduced to server-side concepts and learn how a website communicates with a database. The course ends with a small website project.

## Duration
10 weeks (60 training hours).

## Prerequisites
- Basic computer and internet skills.
- No previous programming experience is required.

## Target Audience
- Beginners interested in building websites.
- University students who want practical web development skills.
- People preparing to pursue a career in front-end or full-stack development.

## Learning Outcomes
By the end of the course, students will be able to:
- Create web pages using HTML.
- Style pages using CSS.
- Add interactivity using JavaScript.
- Understand basic server and database concepts.
- Build and present a simple website.

## Schedule
Sunday, Tuesday, and Thursday, 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

## Course Fee
200 JOD.
